questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes “aldol reaction”?

options.label: A
options.text: The base-induced self-condensation of an ester possessing alpha-hydrogens to produce a beta-keto ester.

options.label: B
options.text: A two-step synthetic sequence combining a Michael addition with an intramolecular aldol condensation to construct a fused six-membered cyclohexenone ring.

options.label: C
options.text: An aldol condensation between two different carbonyl compounds, optimized when one partner lacks alpha-hydrogens or via preformed LDA enolates.

options.label: D
options.text: The base- or acid-catalyzed addition of an enol or enolate to an aldehyde or ketone to produce a beta-hydroxy carbonyl compound.
